posts:
Anthony Albanese urges US and China to cooperate on AI regulation.
Evidence: Global rules proposed, Copyright exemptions weighed, Tech giants lobbying
#Aletheia #AI #Geopolitics

Prime Minister Albanese calls for a global framework and US-China treaty on AI to ensure humans stay in control.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.2) — Good Preference

While pushing global cooperation, Australia weighs copyright carve-outs for tech giants, yielding to corporate lobbying over sovereign safety.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.4, -0.5) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: COND — The Path of Deception.
Stated ideals of human-centric AI mask pragmatic compliance with corporate tech lobbies.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 3.2, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Albanese AI Plea: COND (+0.6, 0.0) — Well-meaning rhetoric lacks teeth.
- Corporate Lobbying: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Compromising IP laws for tech.
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese visited Apple's HQ in Cupertino ahead of the UN General Assembly, urging a US-China AI pact while navigating domestic copyright laws.

The Poison:
Rushing to accommodate tech giants with copyright exemptions under the guise of attracting innovation undermines local creative industries.

The Plane Error & Switch:
Confusing WHAT (global tech rules) with WHO (corporate lobbyists drafting exemptions). The bait is human safety; the switch is corporate data access.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by framing corporate concessions as national competitiveness. Transparency is traded for investment pretexts.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic entropy rises as policy yields to capital.

The Unavoidable Truth: International cooperation is vital for managing autonomous technological risks.

The Unavoidable Lie: Exempting tech giants from copyright laws will protect everyday creatives.
